items.text: Confirm what VoiceStudio is, its requirements and install steps
Check this computer: OS, Python, git, disk space, GPU, RAM
Download the official Windows installer script and read it before running it
Run the installer and verify the installed files are complete
Clone the VoiceStudio repository into D:\WebDevProjects2, including its submodule
Let first-run setup build the Python engine and verify it finished (ready marker, CPU torch, 464 packages)
Verify VoiceStudio launches, its window responds, and its local service is listening
Download voice models inside the app (needs the person's choice in the app)
